ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The basic structure of the electric pickup in an electric guitar is shown in the figure. The metal strings near the magnet are magnetized, so when the strings vibrate, an induced current is generated in the coil, and after the current is amplified by the circuit, it is transmitted to the speaker to produce sound. Which of the following statements are correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: After removing the magnet in the electric pickup of the electric guitar, can the electric guitar still work normally?

matched_variant_raw.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text: After removing the magnet in the electric pickup of the electric guitar, can the electric guitar still work normally?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: After removing the magnet in the electric pickup of the electric guitar, can the electric guitar still work normally?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the left side is an electric guitar, and the right side shows an enlarged schematic of the structure of the electric pickup: the string labeled “metal string” is located near the magnet; the magnet is labeled with N and S poles, and the magnet passes through or is close to the wound “coil”; the two ends of the coil are connected to the circuit terminals labeled “to amplifier.” According to the question stem, the metal string near the magnet is magnetized, and when the string vibrates, it changes the magnetic flux in the coil, thereby generating an induced current and outputting it through the amplifier. If the magnet in the pickup is removed, there will be a lack of the stable magnetic field provided by the pickup near the coil, and the metal string will also be difficult to magnetize; when the string vibrates, it cannot cause an effective change in the magnetic flux of the coil, so it cannot generate a normal induced current signal. Therefore, the electric guitar cannot work normally.
